text_devanagari: ये त्रि॑ष॒प्ताः प॑रि॒यन्ति॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ बिभ्र॑तः । वा॒चस्पति॒र्बला तेषां॑ त॒न्वो अ॒द्य द॑धातु मे ॥ १ ॥
structural_marker: '॥ ओं ॥' centered on its own line above the first line of text; marginal sūkta numeral '॥ १ ॥' in the right margin level with this mantra's first line; oval BSB (BAYERISCHE STAATSBIBLIOTHEK MUENCHEN) stamp in the upper margin; leaf carries no running head.

text_devanagari: पुन॒रेहि॑ वाचस्पते दे॒वेन॒ मन॑सा स॒ह । वसोष्पते॒ नि र॑मय॒ मय्ये॒वास्तु॒ मयि॑ श्रु॒तम् ॥ २ ॥
structural_marker: No structural marks beside these two lines; leaf carries no running head.

text_devanagari: इ॒हैवाभि वि त॑नू॒भे आर्त्नी॑ इव॒ ज्यया॑ । वा॒चस्पति॒र्नि य॑छतु॒ मय्ये॒वास्तु॒ मयि॑ श्रु॒तम् ॥ ३ ॥
structural_marker: No structural marks beside these two lines; leaf carries no running head.

text_devanagari: उप॑हूतो वा॒चस्पति॒रुपा॒स्मान्वा॒चस्पति॑र्ह्वयताम् । सं श्रु॒तेन॑ गमेमहि॒ मा श्रु॒तेन॒ वि रा॑धिषि ॥ ४ ॥
structural_marker: This mantra's first line is the last line of the upper band and the first line of the lower band; blank line separates it from the next sūkta. No running head.

text_devanagari: वि॒द्मा श॒रस्य॑ पि॒तरं॑ प॒र्जन्यं॒ भूरि॑धायसम् । वि॒द्मो [?]स्य॑ मा॒तरं॑ पृथि॒वीं भूरि॑वर्पसम् ॥ १ ॥
structural_marker: Marginal sūkta numeral '॥ २ ॥' in the right margin level with this mantra's first line. One conjunct in the second line (second akṣara of the word ending -स्य) could not be resolved between ध्व and ष्व and is written [?].

text_devanagari: ज्या॑के॒ परि णो न॒माश्मा॑नं त॒न्वं कृधि । वी॒डुर्व॑री॒यो ऽरा॑ती॒रप॒ द्वेषां॒स्या कृ॑धि ॥ २ ॥
structural_marker: No structural marks beside these two lines; leaf carries no running head.

text_devanagari: वृ॒क्षं यज्ञाव॑ः परिष्वजा॒ना अ॑नुस्फु॒रं श॒रमर्चन्त्यृ॒भुम् । शरु॑म॒स्मद्या॑वय दि॒द्युमि॑न्द्र ॥ ३ ॥
structural_marker: The second line of this mantra is set indented to the right, ending at the right text edge; no marginal numerals.

text_devanagari: यथा॒ द्यां च॑ पृथि॒वीं चा॒न्तस्तिष्ठ॑ति॒ तेज॑नम् । ए॒वा रोगं॑ चास्रा॒वं चा॒न्तस्तिष्ठ॑तु॒ मुञ्ज॒ इत् ॥ ४ ॥
structural_marker: Foot of the leaf below this mantra: signature 'अथर्ववेद' at bottom left and printed page numeral '१' at bottom right.
